LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 2.3.1 FORMS OF VERB ‘DO’

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Language use 2.3.1 Forms of verb ‘do’
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 2.3.1 Forms of verb ‘do’, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you construct sentences using different forms of the verb ‘do’?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 2.3.1 Forms of verb ‘do’ together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak engagingly is enhanced as they use the different forms of the verb ‘do’ to construct

sentences.

• Digital literacy: The learner’s ability to interact with digital devices with digital devices with assistive technology is enhanced as they type sentences

on a digital device.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers in playing language games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is improved through the use of the various forms of the verb ‘do’ correctly in communication.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to apply the knowledge acquired on the different forms of the verb ‘do’ in learning of similar concept in Kiswahili and Indigenous

Languages Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

• Print textbooks in appropriate font size and colour contrast

• Braille books

• Digital devices with assistive technology,

• Charts, flash cards or braille cards,

• Pictures or picture description
